title.zh: 卷一百三十二 志第八十五 樂七
title.raw: 卷一百三十二 志第八十五 樂七 Volume 132 Treatises 85: Music 7

translations.literal: Music Seven
translations.idiomatic: Music 7

translations.literal: (Music Section One)
translations.idiomatic: (Music Section One)

sentences.zh: ○郊祀祈穀雩祀五方帝感生帝建隆郊祀八曲

translations.literal: ○ Suburban sacrifice, prayer-for-grain, rain-prayer sacrifice to the Five Directional Emperors and the Regeneration Emperor — eight pieces from the Jianlong suburban sacrifice
translations.idiomatic: Suburban sacrifice, prayer-for-grain and rain-prayer rites to the Five Directional Emperors and the Regeneration Emperor: eight hymns from the Jianlong suburban sacrifice

sentences.zh: 降神，《高安》在國南方，時維就陽。

translations.literal: Descent of the Spirit, the cited text: In the south of the state, the season now approaches yang.
translations.idiomatic: Descent of the Spirit, to the tune the cited text: In the south of the realm, the season now turns toward the yang.

translations.literal: To pray for the Emperor's blessing, thereby to bring the people to peace.
translations.idiomatic: We pray for the Emperor's grace, that the people may live in peace.

translations.literal: Beans, bamboo trays, tripods and stands; metal, stone, silk and reeds.
translations.idiomatic: Offerings in vessels great and small, and music of metal, stone, silk, and pipe.

translations.literal: Ritual proceeds and music is performed; the imperial fortune is without bounds.
translations.idiomatic: As ritual unfolds and music sounds, may the imperial fortune know no end.

sentences.zh: 皇帝升降，《隆安》步武舒遲，升壇肅祗。

translations.literal: The Emperor's ascent and descent, the cited text: His steps are leisurely and slow; ascending the altar, he is reverently solemn.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's ascent and descent, to the tune the cited text: His pace is measured and unhurried; mounting the altar, he is grave and reverent.

translations.literal: His bearing is truly fitting; it is proper to the rites.
translations.idiomatic: His bearing is wholly becoming—exactly as the rites require.

sentences.zh: 奠玉幣，《嘉安》嘉玉製幣，以通神明。

translations.literal: Presentation of jade and silks, the cited text: Fine jade fashioned into offerings, to communicate with the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of jade and silks, to the tune the cited text: Noble jade shaped into offerings, to reach the spirits on high.

translations.literal: The spirits do not enjoy the things themselves; they enjoy one's utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits do not delight in gifts alone—they accept the offering only when sincerity is complete.

sentences.zh: 奉俎，《豐安》笙鏞備樂，繭栗陳牲。

translations.literal: Presentation of the stand, the cited text: Pipes and bells complete the music; silkworm cocoons and chestnuts array the victims.
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of the offering stand, to the tune the cited text: Pipes and bells fill the hall with music; cocoons and chestnuts accompany the sacrificial beasts.

translations.literal: Then the fragrant stand is welcomed, to present to the lofty and bright.
translations.idiomatic: The fragrant stand is brought forward, offered up to the exalted and luminous Powers.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《禧安》丹雲之爵，金龍之杓。

translations.literal: Libation and offering, the cited text: A scarlet-cloud goblet, a golden-dragon ladle.
translations.idiomatic: Libation and offering, to the tune the cited text: A goblet like crimson clouds, a ladle wrought with golden dragons.

translations.literal: Drawn from the jars and urns—this is called the clear libation.
translations.idiomatic: Drawn from the great jars and urns—this is the clear libation.

sentences.zh: 飲福，《禧安》潔茲五齊，酌彼六尊。

translations.literal: Receiving the blessing, the cited text: Purify these five brews; pour from those six great vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the blessing, to the tune the cited text: Purify the five grades of ale; pour from the six great urns.

translations.literal: When sincerity reaches its utmost, following the rites becomes ever more earnest.
translations.idiomatic: When sincerity is brought to its height, observance of the rites grows ever more devout.

translations.literal: To obtain great blessing, and forever exalt posterity.
translations.idiomatic: May great blessing be granted, and posterity flourish forever.

translations.literal: Repeated radiance and accumulated harmony—the imperial Way is thereby honored.
translations.idiomatic: Radiance upon radiance, harmony heaped upon harmony—the Way of the Emperor stands supreme.

sentences.zh: 亞獻、終獻，《正安》謂天蓋高，其聽孔卑。

translations.literal: Second and final offerings, the cited text: We say Heaven is lofty indeed, yet Its hearing is profoundly near.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings, to the tune the cited text: Heaven is said to be high above, yet Its hearing draws near to the lowly.

translations.literal: Hearing the music, It delights in virtue, and bestows blessing and joy.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing the music, Heaven delights in virtue and grants blessing and joy.

sentences.zh: 送神，《高安》倏兮而來，忽兮而回。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, the cited text: Swiftly It comes; suddenly It returns.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit, to the tune the cited text: In a flash It arrives; in an instant It departs.

translations.literal: Cloud-chariot far and dim; the Heavenly Gate opens wide.
translations.idiomatic: The cloud-chariot fades into the distance; the Gate of Heaven swings open.

translations.literal: Eight pieces from the Xianping personal suburban sacrifice
translations.idiomatic: These are eight hymns from the Xianping imperial suburban sacrifice.

translations.literal: Descent of the Spirit, the cited text: Where is the Round Mound?
translations.idiomatic: Descent of the Spirit, to the tune the cited text: Where lies the Round Mound?

translations.literal: In the yang of the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the southern quarter of the realm.

translations.literal: Rites to the spirits in combined sacrifice; fortune unfolds without bounds.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits are honored in one great rite; destiny opens without limit.

translations.literal: Ancestors come to approach; bamboo trays and beans are set in rows.
translations.idiomatic: Forebears draw near; trays and vessels stand in ordered rows.

translations.literal: The ceremony is solemn and grave; blessings descend in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: The rite is grave and still; blessings pour down in plenty.

sentences.zh: 皇帝升降，《隆安》禮備樂成，乾健天行。

translations.literal: The Emperor's ascent and descent, the cited text: Rites complete and music accomplished; Qian is strong, Heaven moves.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's ascent and descent, to the tune the cited text: Rites are complete and music fulfilled; Heaven's vigor moves as the creative force.

translations.literal: The Emperor's bearing is reverent; jade pendants ring and clang.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's bearing is solemn; his jade pendants chime and ring.

sentences.zh: 奠玉幣，《嘉安》定位毖祀，告於神明。

translations.literal: Presentation of jade and silks, the cited text: The site is fixed for the pure sacrifice; announcement is made to the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of jade and silks, to the tune the cited text: The place is set for the solemn rite; word is sent to the spirits on high.

translations.literal: Fine jade and measured silks—enjoyment lies in utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Noble jade and measured offerings—the spirits accept only when sincerity is complete.

sentences.zh: 奉俎，《豐安》有牲斯純，有俎斯陳。

translations.literal: Presentation of the stand, the cited text: Victims there are, pure; stands there are, displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of the offering stand, to the tune the cited text: Pure victims are ready; the stands are set in place.

translations.literal: Presented to the Supreme Lord, clearly reporting deep benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: They are offered to the Supreme Lord, proclaiming His deep benevolence.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《禧安》大報於帝，盛德升聞。

translations.literal: Libation and offering, the cited text: Great report to the Emperor; abundant virtue rises and is heard.
translations.idiomatic: Libation and offering, to the tune the cited text: Great tribute is paid to the Lord on High; resplendent virtue rises and is heard.

translations.literal: Sacrificial ale pure and fine; grain offerings fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremonial ale is pure and fine; the grain offerings are fragrant.

sentences.zh: 飲福，《禧安》祀帝圜丘，九州獻力。

translations.literal: Receiving the blessing, the cited text: Sacrificing to the Lord at the Round Mound; the Nine Provinces offer their strength.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving the blessing, to the tune the cited text: The Lord is worshipped at the Round Mound; the Nine Provinces bring their tribute.

translations.literal: Rites performed in the suburbs; the hundred spirits receive their offices.
translations.idiomatic: The rite is performed in the suburbs; the hundred spirits take up their stations.

translations.literal: Spirits and earthly powers draw near in thought; they enjoy our bright virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits and earthly powers draw near; they accept our shining virtue.

translations.literal: Heaven's mirror is greatly manifest; dark blessing is clearly bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's gaze is clear and bright; hidden blessings are openly granted.

sentences.zh: 亞獻、終獻，《正安》羽籥雲罷，幹戚載揚。

translations.literal: Second and final offerings, the cited text: Feather-flutes like clouds cease; shields and axes are raised aloft.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings, to the tune the cited text: The feather-flutes fall silent like clouds; shields and axes are brandished on high.

translations.literal: Receiving the spirits with reverence; blessings granted without bounds.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits are welcomed with reverence; blessings flow without end.

sentences.zh: 送神，《高安》神駕來思，風舉雲飛。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, the cited text: The spirit-carriage comes; wind rises and clouds fly.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit, to the tune the cited text: The spirit-carriage approaches; wind lifts and clouds soar.

translations.literal: The spirit-chariot returns and halts; the sky is clear and dew dries.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit-chariot returns and rests; the sky clears and the dew fades.

sentences.zh: 景祐親郊，三聖並侑二首

translations.literal: Two pieces from the Jingyou personal suburban sacrifice, with the Three Sages jointly enshrined
translations.idiomatic: Two hymns from the Jingyou imperial suburban sacrifice, with the Three Sages jointly enshrined

sentences.zh: 奠幣，《廣安》千齡啟運，三後在天。

translations.literal: Presentation of silks, the cited text: A thousand ages open fortune; the three sovereigns are in Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of silks, to the tune the cited text: A thousand ages begin their course; the three sovereigns dwell in Heaven.

translations.literal: The fine altar with joint enshrinement—myriad millions of years.
translations.idiomatic: At the noble altar they are jointly enshrined—may it endure for ten thousand ages.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《彰安》皇基締構，帝係靈長。

translations.literal: Libation and offering, the cited text: The imperial foundation is founded and built; the imperial line is numinous and enduring.
translations.idiomatic: Libation and offering, to the tune the cited text: The imperial foundation is laid; the imperial line is sacred and long.

translations.literal: In person offering the fragrant ale; descendants preserve prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: He himself offers the fragrant ale; may his descendants flourish in prosperity.

translations.literal: Two pieces for the regular sacrifice
translations.idiomatic: These are two hymns for the regular sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 太祖配位奠幣，《定安》翕受駿命，震疊群方。

translations.literal: Presentation of silks at the enshrinement place of Taizu, the cited text: He received the grand mandate; he shook and folded the regions.
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of silks at Taizu's associated seat, to the tune the cited text: He received the great mandate and awed the realms on every side.

translations.literal: Jointly worshipping the Supreme Lord; virtue deep, radiance flowing.
translations.idiomatic: He assists in worship of the Supreme Lord; his deep virtue shines on and on.

sentences.zh: 酌獻，《英安》誕受靈符，肇基丕業。

translations.literal: Libation and offering, the cited text: He received the numinous tally at birth; he founded the great enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Libation and offering, to the tune the cited text: He received the sacred tally and founded the great enterprise.

translations.literal: Associated in enjoyment with pure offerings; forever exalted for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: He shares in the pure offerings; may his line flourish for ten thousand generations.

translations.literal: Five pieces from the Yuanfu personal suburban sacrifice
translations.idiomatic: These are five hymns from the Yuanfu imperial suburban sacrifice.

translations.literal: (The remainder is the same as Xianping; wherever anything is missing, the old lyrics are used)
translations.idiomatic: (The remainder follows the Xianping version; wherever a piece is lacking, the old lyrics are used)

translations.literal: Descent of the Spirit, the cited text
translations.idiomatic: Descent of the Spirit, to the tune the cited text

translations.literal: (The words for the six changes are the same)
translations.idiomatic: (The lyrics for the six changes are the same)

translations.literal: Non-action extends to no distance; deep and thick, broad the domain.
translations.idiomatic: Non-action reaches to every distance; deep and vast is the realm.

translations.literal: Sacrificing to the spirits with reverence present; cap and coronet, embroidered robes.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits are worshipped with reverence; cap and coronet, embroidered robes are worn.

translations.literal: Grain offerings abundant and fine; bright virtue fragrant and radiant.
translations.idiomatic: Grain offerings are rich and fine; bright virtue shines with fragrance.

translations.literal: With auspice and with protection—not a narrow prayer alone.
translations.idiomatic: With blessing and with protection—not a narrow prayer for oneself alone.

translations.literal: Ascent and descent, the cited text
translations.idiomatic: Ascent and descent, to the tune the cited text

translations.literal: (Jar-washing and receiving the blessing are performed together)
translations.idiomatic: (Jar-washing and receiving the blessing are performed to the same tune)

translations.literal: Spirits surround and guard; splendor follows and clouds attend.
translations.idiomatic: Spirits surround and guard him; splendor follows and clouds attend.

translations.literal: Jade countenance warm and pure; Heaven's pace leisurely and slow.
translations.idiomatic: His jade-like bearing is warm and pure; his heavenly pace is measured and unhurried.

translations.literal: Turning as he ascends and descends; the imperial heart is reverently solemn.
translations.idiomatic: As he moves in ascent and descent, the imperial heart is grave and reverent.

translations.literal: A thousand spirits protect; a hundred blessings are fitting.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand spirits guard him; every blessing is his due.

sentences.zh: 退文舞、迎武舞，《正安》左手執籥，右手秉翟。

translations.literal: Withdrawing the civil dance and welcoming the martial dance, the cited text: In the left hand holding the flute; in the right hand grasping the pheasant-feather staff.
translations.idiomatic: Withdrawing the civil dance and welcoming the martial dance, to the tune the cited text: The left hand holds the flute; the right hand grasps the pheasant-feather staff.

translations.literal: Advancing in ranks, withdrawing in ranks; the myriad dances are grand.
translations.idiomatic: They advance in ranks and withdraw in ranks; the myriad dancers move in splendor.

sentences.zh: 徹豆，《熙安》陟彼郊丘，大祀是承。

translations.literal: Removal of the beans, the cited text: Ascending that suburban mound; the great sacrifice is undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: Removal of the offerings, to the tune the cited text: Ascending that suburban mound, the great sacrifice is fulfilled.

translations.literal: The beans are very many; the fragrance now first rises.
translations.idiomatic: The offerings are plentiful; their fragrance now first rises.

translations.literal: The Supreme Lord at this time delights; because of our pure clarity.
translations.idiomatic: The Supreme Lord accepts the offering in due season, for our pure devotion.

translations.literal: The affair completed and withdrawn; blessing and emolument come to fulfillment.
translations.idiomatic: The rite is completed and the offerings withdrawn; blessing and fortune are fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 送神，《景安》馨遺八尊，器空二簋。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, the cited text: Fragrant remnants in eight great vessels; vessels empty, two grain bowls.
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit, to the tune the cited text: Fragrance lingers in eight great urns; the vessels are emptied, two grain bowls remain.

translations.literal: Utmost prayer, utmost reverence; the vault and earthly powers bestow blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Prayer at its height, devotion at its depth—the Powers on high grant their blessing.

translations.literal: Three pieces from the Zhenghe personal suburban sacrifice
translations.idiomatic: These are three hymns from the Zhenghe imperial suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 皇帝升降，《乾安》因山為高，爰陟其首。

translations.literal: The Emperor's ascent and descent, the cited text: Taking the mountain as height, then ascending its summit.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's ascent and descent, to the tune the cited text: The mountain is made his height, and he climbs to its summit.

translations.literal: Jade feet leaping lightly, at the Lord's left and right.
translations.idiomatic: His jade-like steps are light and swift, at the Lord's left and right.

translations.literal: The Lord says to our king: I cherish your benevolence and depth.
translations.idiomatic: The Lord says to our king: I hold your benevolence and depth in my heart.

translations.literal: Looking back with care upon him, forever pacifying the Nine Possessions.
translations.idiomatic: Looking back upon him with favor, may he forever bring peace to the realm.

sentences.zh: 配位酌獻，《大寧》於穆文祖，妙道九德。

translations.literal: Libation and offering at the associated seat, the cited text: Solemn is the civil Ancestor; wondrous Way, nine virtues.
translations.idiomatic: Libation and offering at the associated seat, to the tune the cited text: Solemn is the civil Ancestor, of wondrous Way and ninefold virtue.

translations.literal: Silent accord with the numinous heart; he founded the royal traces.
translations.idiomatic: In silent accord with the numinous heart, he laid the foundations of the royal house.

translations.literal: He opens and protects later men; abundance extends without limit.
translations.idiomatic: He opens the way and protects posterity; his bounty flows without end.

translations.literal: Combined food clearly presented; filial thought is the rule.
translations.idiomatic: Joint offerings are clearly presented; filial devotion is the standard.

translations.literal: Ah, the glorious Compliant Ancestor; accumulated virtue, heaped auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Glorious is the Compliant Ancestor, whose virtue and blessing have piled up through the ages.

translations.literal: The source issued deep and thick; he does not display his radiance.
translations.idiomatic: His source runs deep and strong; he does not flaunt his glory.

translations.literal: He laid the foundation of Heaven's bright mandate; his depth could bring prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: He laid the foundation of Heaven's bright mandate; his depth brought lasting prosperity.

translations.literal: Thus filial, thus enjoying; extended bestowal without bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Filial in worship, rich in offering—blessings are granted without end.

sentences.zh: 高宗建炎初，國步尚艱，乃詔有司，天帝地祗及他大祀，先以時舉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jianyan era under Gaozong, the state's course was still difficult; thereupon he decreed the responsible offices that sacrifices to the Heavenly Emperor, Earthly Spirits, and other great sacrifices should first be held at the proper season.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jianyan era, when Gaozong's fortunes were still precarious, he ordered the responsible offices to hold sacrifices to the Heavenly Emperor, the Earthly Spirits, and other major rites at the proper seasons without delay.

sentences.zh: 太常尋奏，近已增募樂工，幹、羽、簨、虡亦備，始循舊禮，用登歌樂舞。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices soon memorialized that they had recently increased and recruited music workers; shields, feathers, banners and stands were also prepared, and they began to follow the old rites, using ascending song, music and dance.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices soon reported that they had recently recruited additional musicians, and that shields, feathers, banners, and stands were all in readiness; they had begun to follow the old rites, employing the ascending hymns with music and dance.

translations.literal: The sacrifice was to the August Heaven, the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrifice was offered to the August Heaven, the Supreme Lord.

translations.literal: For Descent of the Spirit, the cited text is used.
translations.idiomatic: For Descent of the Spirit, the hymn the cited text is used.

sentences.zh: 圜鍾為宮，三奏蒐講上儀，式修毖祀。

translations.literal: Round Bell as gong: three performances—gathering the supreme rites, thereby performing the pure sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: With the Round Bell as keynote, three movements unfold: the supreme ritual is reviewed, and the pure sacrifice is duly performed.

translations.literal: The day is auspicious, the hour is fine; the rites are complete, the music is prepared.
translations.idiomatic: The day is auspicious and the hour propitious; ritual is fulfilled and the music stands ready.

translations.literal: Wind-chariots and cloud-banners—forthwith they come to delight and alight.
translations.idiomatic: Wind-chariots and cloud-banners draw near; the spirits come in joy and take their place.

translations.literal: Commend our fragrant virtue; grant this abundant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Bless our fragrant virtue, and grant these abundant blessings.

sentences.zh: 黃鍾為角，一奏我將我享，涓選休成。

translations.literal: Yellow Bell as jiao: one performance—'I shall offer, I shall enjoy'; careful selection brings fine completion.
translations.idiomatic: With Yellow Bell as the horn tone, the first movement rises: 'I shall present, I shall receive'—careful selection brings all to perfection.

translations.literal: The officers in charge are reverent; sole diligence, sole purity.
translations.idiomatic: The officiants serve with utmost reverence—in diligence alone and purity alone.

translations.literal: The music has completed the six changes; solemn and harmonious, the notes ring forth.
translations.idiomatic: When the music has passed through its six changes, solemn harmony fills the air.

translations.literal: Lofty on high on high—may It deign to hear.
translations.idiomatic: High above, high above—may You incline to hear.

sentences.zh: 太簇為徵，一奏禮崇禋祀，備物薦誠。

translations.literal: Great Cluster as zhi: one performance—rites honor the suburban sacrifice; all offerings are prepared to present sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: With Great Cluster as the melody tone, the first movement rises: the rites exalt the suburban sacrifice, and every offering is set forth in sincerity.

translations.literal: Clearly reaching the vast heavens; bright virtue alone is fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Clearly reaching the vast vault of Heaven—bright virtue alone is fragrant.

translations.literal: Wind-horses and cloud-chariots come to approach and delight in reception.
translations.idiomatic: Wind-horses and cloud-chariots come to approach and delight in the offering.

translations.literal: Extended bestowal without bounds; grant our thoughts fulfillment.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings are extended without end, and our prayers are brought to fulfillment.

sentences.zh: 姑洗為羽，一奏惟天為大，物始攸資。

translations.literal: Gu Xian as yu: one performance—'Heaven alone is great'; all things rely on it from the beginning.
translations.idiomatic: With Gu Xian as the feather tone, the first movement rises: 'Heaven alone is great'—all things depend on it from the very start.

translations.literal: Reverently undertaking the suburban sacrifice, to repay and to pray.
translations.idiomatic: We reverently undertake the suburban sacrifice, both to give thanks and to pray.

translations.literal: The spirit cannot be measured; daily oversight is here.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit cannot be fathomed—day by day It watches from here.

translations.literal: There is fragrant bright virtue; may it reach the thoughts.
translations.idiomatic: Fragrant bright virtue is here; may it reach the divine mind.

sentences.zh: 皇帝盥洗，《正安》靈承上帝，厲意專精。

translations.literal: The Emperor's hand-washing, the cited text: The spirit receives the Supreme Lord; intent is keen and wholly refined.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's hand-washing, to the tune the cited text: The spirit receives the Supreme Lord; his mind is keen and wholly refined.

translations.literal: The washing stand is set at the eastern steps; urn water is made pure.
translations.idiomatic: The washing stand is set at the eastern steps, and water in the urn is made pure.

translations.literal: Washing to achieve cleanliness; feeling penetrates the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: By washing he achieves purity, and feeling reaches the spirits.

translations.literal: Nothing far does not arrive; may It enjoy this sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing distant lies beyond reach; may the spirits accept this sincerity.

sentences.zh: 升壇，《正安》皇矣上帝，神格無方！

translations.literal: Ascending the altar, the cited text: Grand is the Supreme Lord; the spirit arrives without limit!
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the altar, to the tune the cited text: Grand is the Supreme Lord; the spirit arrives from every quarter!

translations.literal: One yang begins to return; canonical sacrifices have their constant.
translations.idiomatic: As the first yang stirs again, the canonical sacrifices keep their fixed season.

translations.literal: Beans are set forth, abundant and fine; virtuous fragrance is presented.
translations.idiomatic: The vessels are heaped high with rich offerings; fragrant virtue is presented.

translations.literal: Assisting sincerity abides in delight; blessings descend abundantly.
translations.idiomatic: With assisting sincerity the spirits dwell in joy, and blessings descend in abundance.

sentences.zh: 上帝位奠玉幣，《嘉安》治極發聞，不瑕有芬。

translations.literal: Presentation of jade and silks at the Supreme Lord's seat, the cited text: Governance at its peak sends forth renown; without flaw, there is fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of jade and silks at the Supreme Lord's seat, to the tune the cited text: When rule reaches its height renown goes forth; without flaw, fragrance rises.

translations.literal: Fine jade is displayed and silks are offered; the spirit arrives joyfully.
translations.idiomatic: Fine jade and silks are set forth, and the spirit comes in joy.

translations.literal: The sincere heart is clearly displayed; reverent respect without ornament.
translations.idiomatic: Sincerity shines forth clearly; reverence is offered without empty display.

translations.literal: To comfort and to assist—how boundless the solid blessing!
translations.idiomatic: To bring peace and to support the rite—how boundless the blessing granted!

sentences.zh: 太祖位奠幣，《安定》茫茫蒼穹，孰知其紀！

translations.literal: Presentation of silks at the Taizu seat, the cited text: Vast is the dark vault of heaven-who knows its reckonings!
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of silks at the Taizu seat, to the tune the cited text: Vast is the dark vault of heaven-who can know its limits!

translations.literal: Refined thought secretly penetrates; though far, yet near.
translations.idiomatic: Refined intent reaches through in secret; though far away, it draws near.

translations.literal: Measured silks present sincerity; where there is substance, there is the basket.
translations.idiomatic: Silks measured out present sincerity; where there is substance, the basket is filled.

translations.literal: Turning to look upon them, forever bestowing abundant blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Looking back upon them, the spirits forever bestow abundant blessings.

sentences.zh: 皇帝還位，《正安》典祀有常，昭事上帝。

translations.literal: The Emperor returns to his place, the cited text: Canonical sacrifice has its constant; the Supreme Lord is clearly served.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor returns to his place, to the tune the cited text: The canonical sacrifice keeps its fixed order; the Supreme Lord is clearly served.

translations.literal: Offered up to declare reverence, reaching to the presentation of silks.
translations.idiomatic: Offerings are raised to declare reverence, down to the laying out of silks.

translations.literal: Bells and drums are already set; ritual ceremonies are already prepared.
translations.idiomatic: Bells and drums are in place; every ceremony of the rite is ready.

translations.literal: The spirit's arrival in thought; reverently receiving bestowed gifts.
translations.idiomatic: As the spirit draws near, gifts are reverently received.

sentences.zh: 捧俎，《豐安》祀事孔明，禮文惟楙。

translations.literal: Presentation of the offering stand, the cited text: The sacrificial affair is clearly accomplished; ritual texts flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of the offering stand, to the tune the cited text: The sacrifice is luminously complete; ritual splendor abounds.

translations.literal: Then the victims are purified and set upon the stands and beans.
translations.idiomatic: The victims are purified and set upon the stands and beans.

sentences.zh: 或肆或將，無聲無臭，精祲潛通，永綏我後。

translations.literal: Sometimes displayed, sometimes presented; without sound, without smell—refined essence secretly penetrates, forever securing our descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Now displayed, now presented—without sound, without scent—refined essence reaches through in secret, forever securing our descendants.

sentences.zh: 上帝酌獻，《嘉安》氣萌黃鍾，萬物資始。

translations.literal: Libation at the Supreme Lord's seat, the cited text: Qi sprouts at Yellow Bell; ten thousand things rely on the beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Libation at the Supreme Lord's seat, to the tune the cited text: As qi stirs at Yellow Bell, the ten thousand things depend on that beginning.

translations.literal: Reverently as the high vault; auspicious purification at the seasonal sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently, as to the high vault—at the seasonal sacrifice all is purified and made auspicious.

translations.literal: The spirit's writ of Grand Origin; increased grants without end.
translations.idiomatic: By the spirit's writ of Grand Origin, blessings are increased without end.

translations.literal: All living things thrive; vast blessing encompasses all.
translations.idiomatic: All living things flourish; boundless blessing enfolds them.

sentences.zh: 太祖位酌獻，《英安》赫赫翼祖，受命於天。

translations.literal: Libation at the Taizu seat, the cited text: Glorious is the Ancestor of Succor, who received the mandate from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Libation at the Taizu seat, to the tune the cited text: Glorious is the Ancestor of Succor, who received the mandate from Heaven.

translations.literal: Virtue surpassing the Three Dynasties; awes extending to the eight boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: His virtue surpasses the Three Dynasties; his might reaches the eight corners of the realm.

translations.literal: Ascending to pair with the Supreme Lord; the bright suburban sacrifice declares reverence.
translations.idiomatic: He ascends to share the Supreme Lord's place; the bright suburban sacrifice declares reverence.

translations.literal: Flowing radiance extends abundance—for ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing radiance and lasting abundance—for ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 文舞退、武舞進，《正安》大德曰生，陰陽寒暑。

translations.literal: Civil dance withdraws and martial dance advances, the cited text: Great virtue is called 'life-giving'; yin and yang, cold and heat.
translations.idiomatic: Civil dance withdraws and martial dance advances, to the tune the cited text: Great virtue is called life-giving-yin and yang, cold and heat.

translations.literal: Music and dance express form; shields, axes, flutes, and feathers.
translations.idiomatic: Music and dance give form to the rite—shields, axes, pipes, and plumes.

translations.literal: One release, one stretch; retreating ranks, advancing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Now easing, now tightening—ranks withdraw, then ranks advance.

translations.literal: The spirit peacefully delights in it; blessing is granted to the broad realm.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit rests in joy; blessings are granted across the broad realm.

sentences.zh: 亞、終獻，《文安》惟聖普臨，順皇之德。

translations.literal: Second and final offerings, the cited text: Only the Sage universally presides, following the imperial virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Second and final offerings, to the tune the cited text: Only the Sage presides everywhere, in accord with the Emperor's virtue.

translations.literal: Canonical ceremonies have their constant; sacrificial enjoyment without error.
translations.idiomatic: Canonical ceremonies have their fixed rule; the sacrifice is performed without lapse.

translations.literal: Bamboo trays and beans are quietly fine; descending and ascending in harmonious order.
translations.idiomatic: Bamboo trays and beans stand in quiet perfection; offerings descend and ascend in harmonious order.

translations.literal: The spirit is fully intoxicated and at rest; bright gifts are all gathered.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit is fully sated and at rest; bright blessings gather all around.

sentences.zh: 徹豆，《肅安》內心齊誠，外物蠲潔。

translations.literal: Removing the beans, the cited text: Inner heart united in sincerity; outer things purified clean.
translations.idiomatic: Removing the beans, to the tune the cited text: Within, the heart is united in sincerity; without, every offering is purified.

translations.literal: The spirit comes to guide the tasting; stands and beans are already removed.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit comes to guide the tasting; the stands and beans have been cleared away.

translations.literal: Ease extending to all living things; none prematurely cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing reaches all living things; none is cut off before its time.

translations.literal: Blessings descend abundantly—times ten thousand, times a hundred million.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings descend in abundance—by tens of thousands and by hundreds of millions.

sentences.zh: 送神，《景安》於赫上帝，乘龍禦天。

translations.literal: Sending off the Spirit, the cited text: Ah, glorious Supreme Lord, riding a dragon to govern Heaven!
translations.idiomatic: Sending off the Spirit, to the tune the cited text: Ah, glorious Supreme Lord, riding a dragon to govern Heaven!

translations.literal: Only the sage can serve; bright enjoyment is thus reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Only the sage can perform the rite; bright acceptance is offered in reverence.

translations.literal: Presented beans are cleared like clouds; spirit-banners now turn homeward.
translations.idiomatic: The offerings are cleared away like clouds; spirit-banners now turn homeward.

translations.literal: Bearing bestowed restful blessings—may there be years without end.
translations.idiomatic: Restful blessings are bestowed—may the years go on without end.

sentences.zh: 望燎，《正安》靈承上帝，精意感通。

translations.literal: Gazing at the burning, the cited text: The spirit receives the Supreme Lord; refined thought senses penetration.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing at the burning, to the tune the cited text: The spirit receives the Supreme Lord; refined intent reaches through.

translations.literal: Fragrant aroma reaches afar; grain offerings are already abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Fragrant aroma spreads on every side; grain offerings stand rich and full.

translations.literal: Ascent and descent have propriety; sacrifice is complete, music ended.
translations.idiomatic: Ascent and descent follow proper order; the sacrifice is complete and the music ends.

translations.literal: The spirit listens; fortune and emolument come in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit listens; fortune and blessing are heaped high.

sentences.zh: 紹興十三年，初舉郊祀，命學士院製宮廟朝獻及圜壇行禮、登門肆赦樂章，凡五十有八。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Shaoxing, when the suburban sacrifice was first performed, the Hanlin Academy was ordered to compose hymns for palace-temple morning offerings, Round Altar ceremonial movements, and Gate Amnesty—fifty-eight in all.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 13, when the suburban sacrifice was first held, the Hanlin Academy was ordered to compose fifty-eight hymns for palace-temple morning offerings, Round Altar ceremonial movements, and the Gate Amnesty.

sentences.zh: 至二十八年，以臣僚有請改定，於是御製樂章十有三及徽宗元御製仁宗廟樂章一，共十有四篇。

translations.literal: By the twenty-eighth year, because officials petitioned for revision, the Emperor then personally composed thirteen hymns, together with one temple hymn for Emperor Renzong that Huizong had earlier composed—fourteen pieces in all.
translations.idiomatic: By Shaoxing 28, after officials petitioned for revision, the Emperor personally composed thirteen hymns, together with one temple hymn for Emperor Renzong that Huizong had composed earlier—fourteen pieces in all.

sentences.zh: 餘則分命大臣與兩製儒館之士，一新撰述，並懿節別廟樂曲凡七十有四，俱彙見焉。

translations.literal: The remainder was separately assigned to great ministers and scholars of the two academies to compose anew; together with seventy-four pieces for the separate shrine of Empress Yijie, all are compiled here.
translations.idiomatic: The rest were separately assigned to senior ministers and scholars of the two academies for fresh composition; together with seventy-four pieces for Empress Yijie's separate shrine, all are gathered here.

translations.literal: The sacrifice was at the Round Mound.
translations.idiomatic: This section records the sacrifice at the Round Mound.

sentences.zh: 皇帝入中壝，《乾安》帝出於震，巽惟齊明。

translations.literal: The Emperor enters the inner enclosure, the cited text: The Emperor emerges from Zhen; in Xun he is pure and bright.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor enters the inner enclosure, to the tune the cited text: The Emperor emerges from Zhen; in Xun he is pure and bright.

translations.literal: The pitch pipe is Gu Xian, to show purity and clearness.
translations.idiomatic: The pitch pipe is set to Gu Xian, showing purity and cleanness.

sentences.zh: 我交於神，蠲意必精，既盥而往，祈鑒斯誠。

translations.literal: I commune with the spirits; the purified mind must be refined. Having washed, I go forth—pray inspect this sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: I commune with the spirits; my purified intent must be refined. Having washed, I go forward—may You witness this sincerity.

translations.literal: Descent of the Spirit, the cited text
translations.idiomatic: Descent of the Spirit, to the tune the cited text

translations.literal: Yang stirs in the Yellow Palace; the sun revolves toward the southern pole.
translations.idiomatic: Yang stirs in the Yellow Palace; the sun wheels toward the southern pole.

translations.literal: The Heavenly Gate is vast; the hundred spirits receive their duties.
translations.idiomatic: The Heavenly Gate stands wide open; the hundred spirits take up their offices.

translations.literal: Then the purple altar is illumined, deep yellow in its special hue.
translations.idiomatic: Then the purple altar glows, deep yellow in its special splendor.

translations.literal: Spirit, ah, you come in abundance—surely you draw near to virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit, you come in overflowing power—surely you draw near to virtue.

sentences.zh: 盥洗，《乾安》帝顧明德，監於克誠。

translations.literal: Hand-washing, the cited text: The Emperor looks to bright virtue and oversees utmost sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Hand-washing, to the tune the cited text: The Emperor looks to bright virtue and oversees utmost sincerity.

translations.literal: Fasting and cleansing wash—thereby showing purity and cleanness.
translations.idiomatic: By fasting and cleansing he shows purity and cleanness.

translations.literal: At the suburban mound combined sacrifice, the intent of the offering must be refined.
translations.idiomatic: At the combined suburban sacrifice, the intent of the offering must be refined.

translations.literal: Having washed, then offering—the glorious affair is fully complete.
translations.idiomatic: Having washed, he offers up the sacrifice; the glorious rite is fully complete.

sentences.zh: 升壇，《乾安》帝監崇壇，媼神其從。

translations.literal: Ascending the altar, the cited text: The Emperor oversees the lofty altar; the Mother Spirit follows.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending the altar, to the tune the cited text: The Emperor oversees the lofty altar; the Mother Spirit follows.

translations.literal: Examining antiquity's combined sacrifice, jointly assisting the Spirit Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Following antiquity's combined sacrifice, he jointly assists the Spirit Ancestor.

translations.literal: Ascending the steps, he presents jade; sincerity moves and penetrates.
translations.idiomatic: He ascends the steps and presents jade; sincerity moves and penetrates.

translations.literal: Bestowed gifts come like a tripod; blessings received without end.
translations.idiomatic: Bestowed gifts come in abundance; blessings are received without end.

sentences.zh: 昊天上帝位奠玉幣，《嘉安》

translations.literal: Presentation of jade and silks at the August Heaven Supreme Lord's seat, the cited text
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of jade and silks at the August Heaven Supreme Lord's seat, to the tune the cited text

translations.literal: (Imperially composed)
translations.idiomatic: (Imperially composed)

translations.literal: Upper vault, August Heaven—sun and stars hang forth their radiance.
translations.idiomatic: O upper vault, August Heaven—sun and stars hang forth their radiance.

translations.literal: Shining upon the lower earth, the royal domain is protected.
translations.idiomatic: You shine upon the lower earth and protect the royal domain.

translations.literal: Only jade and silk—diligent reverence clearly repays.
translations.idiomatic: With jade and silk alone we repay in diligent reverence and clear devotion.

translations.literal: Forever to assist it—reverently as the supreme Way.
translations.idiomatic: Forever assist it—reverently, as to the supreme Way.

translations.literal: Presentation of jade and silks at the Imperial Earth Spirit's seat, the cited text
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of jade and silks at the Imperial Earth Spirit's seat, to the tune the cited text

translations.literal: (Imperially composed)
translations.idiomatic: (Imperially composed)

translations.literal: Ultimate, ah, is Kun's thickness—mound-like, it rests in stillness.
translations.idiomatic: Ultimate is the thickness of Kun—like a mound, it rests in stillness.

translations.literal: Softly bearing the moving and the rooted, relying on the beginning to complete their nature.
translations.idiomatic: Softly bearing all that moves and all that grows, it gives them their beginning and brings their nature to completion.

translations.literal: Jade's radiance, the silks' hue—brilliant as if mirrored in reflection.
translations.idiomatic: The jade gleams and the silks shine—brilliant as if caught in a mirror's glow.

translations.literal: Thus reverently perform the suburban sacrifice—there is the state's rejoicing.
translations.idiomatic: With reverence perform the suburban sacrifice—the state rejoices.

translations.literal: Presentation of silk offerings at the Founding Emperor's seat, the cited text
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of silk offerings at the Founding Emperor's seat, to the tune the cited text

translations.literal: (Imperially composed)
translations.idiomatic: (Imperially composed)

translations.literal: Bright, bright—assist the ancestor; jointly assist at the Grand Altar.
translations.idiomatic: Bright and clear—upholding the ancestor; jointly assisted at the Grand Altar.

translations.literal: At the beginning he created the broad realm—the royal enterprise was very arduous.
translations.idiomatic: He first fashioned the broad realm—the founding of the royal enterprise was deeply arduous.

translations.literal: He set right the borders and domains; above it reaches, below it coils.
translations.idiomatic: He set right the borders and domains; above it reaches, below it coils about.

translations.literal: Personally with the great offering—yet it ends only in burning.
translations.idiomatic: He personally makes the great offering—yet it ends in burning alone.

sentences.zh: 太宗皇帝位奠玉幣，《化安》御製。

translations.literal: Presentation of jade and silks at the Taizong Emperor's seat, the cited text, imperially composed.
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of jade and silks at the Taizong Emperor's seat, to the tune the cited text, imperially composed.

translations.literal: Splendid, august—timely and purely glorious.
translations.idiomatic: Splendid and august—timely in pure splendor.

translations.literal: August Heaven completed the mandate; the successor then received it.
translations.idiomatic: August Heaven completed the mandate; the successor received it.

translations.literal: Ascending beyond remote antiquity—his radiance spreads over songs and odes.
translations.idiomatic: He ascends beyond remotest antiquity—his radiance spreads through song and ode.

translations.literal: With silks he ascends in joint offering—what his descendant's plans bequeathed.
translations.idiomatic: With silks he ascends in joint offering—bequeathed by his descendant's design.

sentences.zh: 降壇，《乾安》躬展盛儀，天步逡巡。

translations.literal: Descent from the altar, the cited text: Personally he unfolds the grand ritual; the Heavenly Step moves slowly.
translations.idiomatic: Descent from the altar, to the tune the cited text: He personally unfolds the grand ritual; the Heavenly Step moves with measured pace.

translations.literal: Music complete, rites exchanged; fine jade already displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Music is complete and rites exchanged; fine jade has been displayed.

translations.literal: The spirit just now sits at ease; blessings offered come in profusion.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit now sits at ease; offered blessings come in profusion.

translations.literal: Ascending and descending with dignity; the imperial heart is full of diligence.
translations.idiomatic: Ascent and descent are performed with dignity; the imperial heart is full of diligence.

translations.literal: Return to position, the cited text
translations.idiomatic: Return to position, to the tune the cited text

translations.literal: Able to make manifest the royal enterprise; the mandate is completed before August Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: He makes the royal enterprise manifest; the mandate is fulfilled before August Heaven.

translations.literal: At the Grand Mound, suburban burning—eight tiers, only round.
translations.idiomatic: At the Grand Mound the suburban fire burns—eight tiers, all circular.

translations.literal: Solemn is the august bearing; ascending, descending, turning about.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn is the august bearing; he ascends, descends, and turns about.

translations.literal: This is called a refined offering; the spirits oversee the auspicious purification.
translations.idiomatic: This is called a refined offering; the spirits witness the auspicious purification.

sentences.zh: 奉俎，《豐安》至大惟天，云何稱德！

translations.literal: Presentation of the stand, the cited text: Ultimate in greatness is Heaven alone-how can one name its virtue!
translations.idiomatic: Presentation of the offering stand, to the tune the cited text: Ultimate in greatness is Heaven alone-how can one speak its virtue!

translations.literal: Extending sincerity to offer the tribute; the victims used are broad and fat.
translations.idiomatic: He extends sincerity in offering tribute; the victims are broad and fat.

translations.literal: Sincerity lodges in the victim; the Lord is approached through sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Sincerity dwells in the victim; the Lord is approached through sincerity.

translations.literal: Dwelling in enjoyment, blessings descend—myriad upon myriad, hundred million upon hundred million.
translations.idiomatic: Dwelling in enjoyment, blessings descend—in their myriads and hundreds of millions.

sentences.zh: 再詣盥洗，《乾安》帝出於震，巽惟潔齊。

translations.literal: A second time approaching hand-washing, the cited text: The Emperor emerges from Zhen; in Xun he is purely fasted.
translations.idiomatic: Approaching hand-washing again, to the tune the cited text: The Emperor emerges from Zhen; in Xun he is pure in fasting.

translations.literal: The spirits illumine his virtue—thereby he is called to suburban firewood.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits illumine his virtue—thereby he performs the suburban firewood rite.

translations.literal: Only this auspicious purification; the bright affair is taken to heart.
translations.idiomatic: Only this auspicious purification; the bright rite is embraced in the heart.

translations.literal: Washing again, then sacrificing; broadly bestowed, all share in it.
translations.idiomatic: Washing again, then sacrificing; blessings are broadly bestowed, and all share in them.

sentences.zh: 再升壇與初升同，惟易奠玉作奠酌。

translations.literal: The second ascent of the altar is the same as the first ascent—only changing presentation of jade to presentation of libation.
translations.idiomatic: The second ascent of the altar follows the first—only substituting presentation of jade for presentation of libation.

translations.literal: Libation offering at the August Heaven Supreme Lord's seat, the cited text
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering at the August Heaven Supreme Lord's seat, to the tune the cited text

translations.literal: (Imperially composed)
translations.idiomatic: (Imperially composed)

translations.literal: Reverently approaching the altar terrace, respectfully sacrificing at the Grand suburban rite.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently approaching the altar terrace, he respectfully performs the Grand suburban sacrifice.

translations.literal: The mound is round by nature—one may reach the utmost spirit.
translations.idiomatic: The mound is naturally round—thereby one may reach the utmost spirit.

translations.literal: The cassia vessel ascends for libation; fine offerings are freshly new.
translations.idiomatic: The cassia vessel is raised for libation; fine offerings are freshly made.

translations.literal: No blessing is slight or minute; broadly aiding the people below.
translations.idiomatic: No blessing is slight or small; blessings broadly aid the people below.

translations.literal: Libation offering at the Imperial Earth Spirit's seat, the cited text
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering at the Imperial Earth Spirit's seat, to the tune the cited text

translations.literal: (Imperially composed)
translations.idiomatic: (Imperially composed)

translations.literal: Thick virtue, broad radiance—receiving the primordial brightness.
translations.idiomatic: Thick virtue and broad radiance—receiving the brightness of the primordial.

translations.literal: Now the hidden reed-pipe sounds—rising to bright clearness.
translations.idiomatic: Now the hidden reed-pipe sounds—rising to bright clarity.

translations.literal: Ice sky, cassia sea—all rely on transformation and completion.
translations.idiomatic: From icy north to cassia sea—all receive transformation and cultivation.

translations.literal: Reverently libating with the ritual ale—repaying the root with refinement alone.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently offering the ritual ale—repaying the root with refinement alone.

translations.literal: Libation offering at the Founding Emperor's seat, the cited text
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering at the Founding Emperor's seat, to the tune the cited text

translations.literal: (Imperially composed)
translations.idiomatic: (Imperially composed)

translations.literal: Ah, splendid the imperial ancestor—founding the enterprise, establishing the pole.
translations.idiomatic: Splendid is the imperial ancestor—founding the enterprise, establishing the pole.

translations.literal: Solemn, solemn the numinous mandate; vast, vast the beautiful virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn is his numinous mandate; vast is his beautiful virtue.

translations.literal: Fine libation, refined and pure; elegant performance of metal and stone.
translations.idiomatic: Fine libation, refined and pure; metal and stone play in elegant harmony.

translations.literal: Greatly manifesting divine counsel—only a model for later rulers.
translations.idiomatic: Greatly manifesting divine counsel—a model for rulers who come after.

translations.literal: Libation offering at the Taizong Emperor's seat, the cited text
translations.idiomatic: Libation offering at the Taizong Emperor's seat, to the tune the cited text

translations.literal: (Imperially composed)
translations.idiomatic: (Imperially composed)

translations.literal: Greatly radiant the imperial lineage; again receiving Heaven's mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Greatly radiant the imperial lineage—again receiving Heaven's mandate.

translations.literal: The many yin forces still were wanton; one campaign greatly settled all.
translations.idiomatic: Dark forces still ran riot; one campaign brought great settlement.

translations.literal: The aromatic ale is fragrant; merit-songs are in ode and chant.
translations.idiomatic: The aromatic ale is fragrant; songs of merit are chanted in praise.

translations.literal: Aiding and opening the way for later generations—the literary and the cart-tracks were early set right.
translations.idiomatic: He aids and guides those who come after—the written word and the roads were righted early.

sentences.zh: 還位，《乾安》肆類上帝，懷柔百神。

translations.literal: Return to position, the cited text: Extending sacrifice to the Lord on High, cherishing and softening the hundred spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Return to position, to the tune the cited text: Extending sacrifice to the Lord on High, cherishing and softening the hundred spirits.

translations.literal: Straw and stalks already set out; jade tablets and silks already displayed.
translations.idiomatic: Straw offerings are set out; jade tablets and silks are displayed.

translations.literal: Refined sincerity secretly communes; the affair is done and complete.
translations.idiomatic: Refined sincerity communes in secret; the rite is done and complete.

translations.literal: Aid us for a hundred million ages—the foundation chart daily renewed.
translations.idiomatic: Aid us for ages without end—the foundation ever renewed day by day.

sentences.zh: 入小次，《乾安》恭展美報，聿修上儀。

translations.literal: Entering the lesser pause, the cited text: Reverently extending the fine offering, forthwith repairing the upper ritual.
translations.idiomatic: Entering the lesser recess, to the tune the cited text: Reverently extending the fine offering, forthwith restoring the upper ritual.

translations.literal: Rites and music in harmonious measure; ascending and descending suitably timed.
translations.idiomatic: Rites and music keep harmonious measure; ascent and descent are aptly timed.

translations.literal: With virtue one draws near; no spirit fails to attend.
translations.idiomatic: Through virtue one draws near; no spirit fails to attend.

translations.literal: Within the seas they receive blessing—thereby securing the state's foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Within the seas they receive blessing—thereby securing the foundation of the state.

translations.literal: Civil dance withdraws, martial dance advances, the cited text
translations.idiomatic: The civil dance withdraws and the martial dance advances, to the tune the cited text

translations.literal: Supreme Origin augustly presides; the fertile Mother abundant in blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme Origin presides in majesty; the fertile Mother bestows blessings in abundance.

translations.literal: Ah, the imperial ancestors—already made manifest, they have come to rest.
translations.idiomatic: Splendid are the imperial ancestors—made manifest, they have come to rest.

translations.literal: The dance performed images merit; the spirits surely have joy.
translations.idiomatic: The dance images their merit; the spirits surely rejoice.

translations.literal: Forever we speak of filial thought—utter goodness, utter beauty.
translations.idiomatic: Forever we speak of filial piety—utter goodness, utter beauty.

sentences.zh: 亞獻，《正安》陽丘其高，神祗並位。

translations.literal: Secondary offering, the cited text: The yang mound is lofty; spirits and earthly powers share their seats.
translations.idiomatic: Secondary offering, to the tune the cited text: The yang mound rises high; spirits and earthly powers share their seats.

translations.literal: Immediately he presents that jade; already he offers that ale.
translations.idiomatic: At once he presents the jade; already he offers the ale.

translations.literal: There is also fine virtue—able to assist the careful sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: There is fine virtue as well—able to assist the careful sacrifice.

translations.literal: Fine ale fills the goblet, thereby completing the glorious affair
translations.idiomatic: Fine ale fills the goblet, thereby completing the glorious rite

translations.literal: (The final offering is the same; only change the second libation to a third libation)
